correctness.rationale: Complete-first-return definition and endpoint-run equality reduce possible shorter privileged borders to zero-, one-, or two-one cases (the three-one case cannot have two translated occurrences). A zero-only border forces a=d>max{b,c}; a one-one border necessarily has a third central occurrence; a two-one border requires b=c>=a. Converse exhibits the qualifying zero-only or two-one border, exactly twice. Mapping choose b>c versus c>b, then r=a-max(b,c)-1,s=abs(b-c)-1,t=min(b,c), gives invertible partition count. Separate direct-recursive computation checked all 3876 weight-three words of lengths 3..18. Those tests are corroboration rather than proof for all lengths.
